title: Heavily Optimized
description: The best optimization modpack for version 26.2 and later. This modpack aims to improve preformance and increase fps while also allowing higher render distances. Up to 60% better performance.
body:
### **What is Heavily Optimised?**

Heavily Optimised is the definitive performance-boosting modpack designed for version 26.2 and beyond. Whether you are trying to squeeze every last frame out of an older laptop or pushing ultra-high render distances on a high-end rig, this pack is built to deliver the smoothest gameplay possible.

### **Why Choose This Modpack?**

Vanilla Minecraft can be incredibly demanding, often plagued by micro-stutters, slow chunk generation, and sudden FPS drops. This modpack completely overhauls how the game runs:

**Massive FPS Boosts:** On average, players see an immediate frame rate increase of up to 40%.
**Low-End System Revival:** Lower-end systems see even more dramatic results, reaching up to 60% in extra performance.
**Extended Render Distances:** Breathe new life into your game, finally allowing you to turn up your render distance and graphics settings without ruining your frame rate.

### **What It Adds to the Game**

Instead of adding heavy content mods that alter core gameplay, Heavily Optimised works entirely under the hood. It introduces a carefully selected suite of optimization engines that rewrite how the game handles rendering, lighting, and memory allocation:

**Modern Render Pipelines:** Replaces legacy rendering code with highly efficient algorithms, significantly driving up your base frame rate.
**Rapid Chunk Generation:** Drastically reduces world-loading times and eliminates the annoying lag spikes that happen while flying or exploring.
**Memory & CPU Optimization:** Cleans up memory leaks and reduces overall CPU overhead, ensuring your game stays stable and smooth even during long sessions.
**Granular Video Settings:** Unlocks deeper, more precise control over your graphical settings so you can fine-tune performance to match your exact setup.

**Experience your worlds the way they were meant to be played—completely stutter-free.**
